item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #NLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 FINAL #NLPRSD
Issued at 06:16 AM 27 November 2026

All Thunderstorm Advisories over forecast areas are now terminated. However, all are still advised to continue monitoring for updates.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards. Residents along mountain slope are advised for possible landslides mudslides, rockslides and flash flood.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NLPRSD
Issued at 04:38 PM 26 November 2026

Moderate to occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Benguet(Buguias, Kabayan, Mankayan, Tuba, Sablan, Kapangan, Atok, Tublay, LaTrinidad, BaguioCity), #IlocosSur(Cervantes, Quirino, Suyo, Tagudin, Sigay, GregorioDelPilar, SanEmilio), #MountainProvince(Sadanga, Barlig, Natonin), #Abra(Tubo, Lacub, LicuanBaay, Malibcong, Boliney, Daguioman, Tineg, Sallapadan, Bucloc, Luba, Manabo, Lagangilang, Bucay, SanJuan, Lagayan, Dolores), #LaUnion(Santol, Bangar, Balaoan, Luna, Pugo, Tubao), #Apayao(Conner), #Kalinga(Pasil, Tinglayan, Balbalan, Tanudan, Lubuagan), #Ifugao(Tinoc, Hungduan, Banaue and Mayoyao) within the next 30 mins to 1 hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Benguet(Bakun, Kibungan), #MountainProvince(Sabangan, Bauko, Tadian, Besao, Sagada, Bontoc), #IlocosSur(Sugpon, Alilem) and #LaUnion(Sudipen) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards. Residents along mountain slope are advised for possible landslides mudslides, rockslides and flash flood.

Keep monitoring for updates.
